description: JRC-EU-TIMES: Bioenergy potentials for EU and neighbouring countries is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Biomass potentials > JRC-EU-TIMES: Bioenergy potentials for EU and neighbouring countries", published or maintained by ec.europa.eu (publisher inferred from the link). Categorises potentials and costs for EU28 and neighbouring countries (Iceland, Switzerland, Norway and the Western Balkans countries). Has different scenarios for sustainability. "The High, Medium and Low bioenergy availability scenarios differ in assumptions related to land use, agricultural practices, and protected areas." Data only available as tables in the PDF report. Some people have transcr. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Biomass potentials" lists it under "JRC-EU-TIMES: Bioenergy potentials for EU and neighbouring countries". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support biomass potential inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
